title: Downhill Jam

exclude: zero page: the Jam's pointers, positions, latches and the sound driver's script pointers, all written at run time (jam_init clears $13-$FF)
the event manager's text screen (SKATING TO JAM, written before the load by show_skating_to $FAF0); the Jam neither reads nor writes it (same bytes in entry.vsf and play.vsf, simulator maps)
left by earlier loads after the load stub; the Jam does not write or read them

not the Jam's data: 104 bytes inside file $28 that no instruction reads or writes (simulator maps, opcode scan); 99 of them equal the Downhill Race's attribute map (file $1F, from offset 235), so they look like a stale buffer saved with the file
70 more stale bytes in file $28 after the sound call stacks, unread and unwritten; 69 equal file $1F from offset 493 (the Downhill Race's attribute map)

the tail of file $28 after the last variable ($3D95): 618 bytes no instruction addresses by name, mostly equal to file $1F (the Downhill Race's attribute map), a stale buffer saved with the file. One stray write lands here: bump_check's timer store at $0E08 with X = $FF writes $3E53
screen buffer A (copy_map_chars and copy_map_colours fill it; sprite pointers at $47F8), written at run time over the second half of the font file $2D
the six sprite buffer pairs that unpack_shape fills at run time from the pose shapes (blocks $50-$5B)
between the end of file $2F ($5940) and file $2A ($5A00): High Jump's bytes, not loaded or used by the Jam
forty bytes between files $2A and $29, not loaded by the Jam (High Jump's bytes); copy_map_colours reads them as row 255 of the attribute map when the camera is at the bottom (simulator read map)
forty bytes after file $29, not loaded by the Jam (High Jump's bytes); copy_map_chars reads them as row 255 of the character map when the camera is at the bottom

residue of the move: $B3A2-$B9FE still hold file $2C's bytes from its load at $AA00 (copies of $C3BC-$CA18) past the end of file $30, and $B9FF-$BA19 received the 27 bytes below the file ($A9E5-$A9FF) from move_shape_file; nothing reads them
past the end of file $2E: identical to the shop's snapshot (its unpacked colour maps, file $07, at $E000-$EFFF); the Jam never reads them
the tail of a RAM copy of the KERNAL from an earlier load; unused with the ROM banked out
stale bytes between the loader and the event manager, unchanged since the title; nothing refers to them
include: file $2C is moved under the I/O area by move_shape_file ($2189): pose shapes $D000-$D93F and the pose records $D940-$DFFF, read with $01 = $24 by unpack_shape

io: unpack_shape: the CPU port is $24 (all RAM) from $1361 to $139C, so its reads under $D000 see the pose data
move_shape_file: $01 = $24 from $218F to $21B4 while file $2C is copied up to $BA1A-$DFFE
regions: load stub copied from the resident event manager

load table, raster bands, status texts
jump poses, status layout, joystick handler rows, behaviours, sprite layout, animations, attacks, LESTER's route, lanes, sparkle
the two players' state, cleared by jam_init
screen buffer B and the status lines

pose records, riding and standing banks
